title: The Station: Escape Room
description:
ESCAPE ABANDONED SPACE STATION WITH FRIENDS
Try it solo or with your friends! Online multiplayer for up to 4 players. The best thing - you don't have to stress over time. After all... that is just you and the everlasting cosmos. EXPLORE AND INTERACT
Clues can be hidden in the most unexpected places. You never know what the mysteries of the space station have prepared for you!BE PREPARED TO GET YOUR HANDS DIRTY 
When your life depends on it, you have to give it your best. The solution often turns out more beautiful than the puzzle.DONT FORGET TO EXPERIMENT
Not every puzzle is intended to be solved. Some are in place to test your limits. Others are, in fact, not puzzles at all.
description_short: Escape the confinement of the space station and restart the systems to gain freedom. Cooperative Escape Room style game to challenge yourself and your friends. Seven rooms to solve the amazing and challenging mysteries before the timer runs out!
